summary: Frontend-only regression testing of On Stage 'Performing as' stale-selection bug fix. Login as test@test.com, verified: (1) fresh selector auto-resolves to default profile 'Default Test 2 (Default)', never shows 'Choose context'; (2) dropdown contains only non-empty options (2 options: profile + event, both with real value attributes, no placeholder); (3) stale localStorage 'onstage_selection'='profile:bogus-stale-999' auto-corrects to default profile on load; (4) Start Show from On Stage with stale value succeeds — /api/shows/start returned 200 and modal correctly shows 'Starting show for: Default Test 2'; (5) Requests-tab Start Show flow unchanged and works (existing show was active and Stop Show functional).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~16346 lines — should be split into smaller focused modules for maintainability.
React Router future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) should be opted-in to reduce console noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end. Key localStorage key is 'onstage_selection' (format 'profile:<id>' or 'event:<id>'). Selector summary testid: 'onstage-selector-summary'. Start button testid: 'start-show-btn'. Show start modal opens instead of a browser confirm — its Start Show submit button is inside div.fixed and may need force=True click.
rca of the issue: Original: selection-init effect only fired when selection was empty; a stale localStorage entry (leftover profile/event id no longer in current account) bypassed initialization, causing summary to show 'Choose context' and Start Show to POST bogus profile_id, yielding 'Profile not found' 400. Fix in App.js (~line 2173) now checks whether the persisted selection resolves against current profiles/events and re-homes to default profile if not. handleStartShow (~line 1516) also falls back to default profile when unresolved. Empty placeholder <option> removed from dropdown.
